task.title: `move-tasks` keeps relic warnings when a set-aside refusal fires
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M56). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook move-tasks` drops the relic warnings from its read stage. When a set-aside refusal fires first, the relic conflicts found while reading the source are not in the error; they are only in `copy.fetch` in the JSON result.

## Wanted

Include the relic warnings and conflicts in the refusal.

## Done when

- A refused move with a relic conflict at the source names the conflict in text output.
